scope: MMC5603NJ bounded native selftest and on-demand raw XYZ diagnostic; no compass UI or calibrated heading.

capability_choice.native: 20-bit magnetic measurement, SET/RESET, Auto_SR, automatic selftest and continuous measurement
capability_choice.selected: Native selftest with factory80% thresholds and0x41; on-demand0x21 Auto_SR, about1 raw frame/s; no continuous/IRQ.

conflicts: p8 status table Meas_m_done bit6 differs from p12 example bit1; use table, actual device pending.
Controls/ODR/thresholds are write-only; SDK control readback/PowerDown are not valid restoration evidence.

implementation.commands: wf_mag start1..120 | stop | status; command/cache only, existing sensor worker owns I2C3/0x30.
implementation.startup: Check ID0x10, own before write, sensor-local reset20ms/OTP; never power-cycle shared PA30.
implementation.sampling: One outstanding on-demand trigger; require DONE0 before trigger, DONE1 before9B read and DONE0 after. Raw centered20-bit counts,6.25nT/count uncalibrated.
implementation.timing: Original session deadline/cancel checked after I/O;50ms only faults when DONE is still absent at observation. Late completed single shot may be read within session; sampled_ms is software read completion, no hardware timestamp.
implementation.stop: Sensor-local reset ACK,20ms wait, ID/OTP ready, drain DONE,20ms no new DONE. Known default stopped baseline only; no arbitrary prior-state restoration/current claim.
implementation.fault: Unconfirmed cleanup retains owned/IDLE; no autonomous I/O retry. Explicit stop/daily recovery may retry.
implementation.coexistence: Same worker serializes daily steps, continuous wrist, auto LTR and MMC. Auto mode/generation unchanged; finite wrist/LTR diagnostics exclude MMC both ways.

tests.scope: Final Debug late-DONE, slow I/O deadline and reverse diagnostic exclusion
